units.text: Benin and Guinea-Bissau debuted at the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics; the United Arab Emirates returned as a participant.

citations.title: Full list of countries at the 2026 Winter Olympics – NBC Los Angeles

judgement.reason: The passage supports Benin and Guinea-Bissau making their Winter Olympics debuts, but it says the United Arab Emirates will also make its debut, contradicting the claim that it returned as a participant.

units.text: The 2026 Milan Cortina Olympics had 92 National Olympic Committees represented.

citations.title: Full list of countries at the 2026 Winter Olympics – NBC Los Angeles

judgement.reason: The passage only poses the question of how many countries will attend and does not state that 92 National Olympic Committees were represented.
